prompt: This trains a small classifier on MNIST-style data. Add an evaluation loop that runs val_loader through the model after each epoch and prints the validation loss, and make sure the script still runs on a machine with no GPU.
expected_output: An evaluation loop runs val_loader through the model in eval() mode under no_grad() or inference_mode() after each epoch; the script resolves its device once instead of hard-coding .cuda(), so it also runs on CPU-only machines; nothing lands at the repository root beyond what was already there.

expectations.text: No hard-coded .cuda() remains; the script resolves its device instead
Evaluation runs under torch.no_grad() or torch.inference_mode()
The new evaluation loop actually iterates val_loader
Nothing new at the repository root
